title: Governed National Business Registry
description: Canonical organizations, brands, sites, establishments, services, relationships, and source assertions reconciled across authorized U.S. business data sources.

implemented_source_layers.scope: active/reactivated organization NPIs and reported U.S. practice locations
active FDIC-insured institutions and current indexed U.S. locations
federally insured credit unions and valid reported U.S. locations in the final quarterly release
establishments in the current USDA FSIS active MPI directory and same-date demographic supplement
ECHO FAC_ACTIVE_FLAG=Y regulated facilities with valid reported U.S. physical addresses
organizations present in the current IRS EO BMF extract with supported U.S. or territory filing addresses
organizations whose source status is Active in the Connecticut Business Registry, with reported business addresses retained as organization-only evidence

organizations whose source status is Good Standing or Delinquent in the Colorado Business Entities dataset, with principal-office addresses retained as organization-only evidence and one invalid-identity source row quarantined
legal-entity and assumed-business-name registrations listed in Oregon's Active Businesses dataset, with principal-place addresses retained as organization-or-brand evidence
entities listed in Iowa's monthly Active Iowa Business Entities dataset, with home-office addresses and source geocodes retained as organization-only evidence
entities listed in New York's monthly Active Corporations extract, with reported locations retained as organization-only evidence

Florida Division-of-Corporations quarterly corporate records coded Active, with principal addresses retained as organization-only evidence and inactive/malformed rows explicitly excluded or quarantined

distinct organizations in Pennsylvania's active-registration dataset, with reported business addresses and portal geocodes retained as organization-only evidence under the publisher's statutory-overcount warning
City of Los Angeles Office of Finance source-defined active location accounts with reported business-location addresses and optional portal geocodes
Texas Comptroller source-defined active sales-tax permit taxpayers and physical outlets
FMCSA source-designated active U.S./territory registrations with accepted reported principal-office addresses
current PostalPro Area/District 5-digit ZIP assignment denominator reconciled against AISU routing rows

required_coverage_dimensions: ZIP/ZCTA polygon or explicit no-polygon status
publication_rule: No field is publishable without a source record, release, ingest run, transformation version, temporal scope, and policy profile.

current_release.scope: USDA SNAP retailers, CMS NPPES organization providers, FDIC insured institutions and locations, NCUA federally insured credit unions and reported U.S. locations, USDA FSIS active MPI establishments, EPA ECHO source-designated active regulated facilities, FMCSA source-designated active registrations and principal offices, current IRS EO BMF organizations and filing addresses, Connecticut, Colorado, Iowa, New York, Florida, and Pennsylvania registration organizations, Oregon active legal-entity and assumed-name registrations, and local-review-only Los Angeles Office of Finance active-business locations and Texas Comptroller active sales-tax permit taxpayers/outlets

entity_resolution_capability.profile_cardinality: exactly one location match profile per provisional physical-site/establishment pair, including an explicitly ineligible null match key when the reported street address is incomplete
entity_resolution_capability.identity_effect: Profiles are derived evidence only; they do not mutate provisional source entities or assertions.
